I have noted that you deny fever, hematuria, back pain, or pelvic pain except during intercourse. Given your 5-month history of suprapubic pain relieved by voiding, frequency, and dysuria, combined with the recent onset of painful intercourse and cloudy urine, I am concerned about interstitial cystitis/bladder pain syndrome, potentially exacerbated by lithium-induced polyuria or a complex UTI.
